facts.claim: Road 2 Web Summit 2026: up to 125 startups, bootcamp, 50% off ALPHA/BETA, Galp prizes
Road 2 Web Summit, designed with Web Summit: its Class of 2026 brings together 78 Portuguese startups from 24 sectors and 14 locations (the call had announced up to 125).
The Portugal stand at Web Summit 2026: Pavilion 1, Stand 145, 10 to 12 November, with Lisboa Municipality; partners AI2, IAPMEI, AICEP, Portugal Ventures (BPF) and Turismo de Portugal.
